                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/max27149/p/22778652" title="发布于 2026-08-31 17:45">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Windows Active Directory + self-service-password(SSP)域控密码自助修改方案</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p></p><div class="toc"><div class="toc-container-header">目录</div><ul><li><a href="#环境准备" rel="noopener nofollow">环境准备</a></li><li><a href="#安装-self-service-password" rel="noopener nofollow">安装 self-service-password</a></li><li><a href="#修改ssp配置" rel="noopener nofollow">修改SSP配置</a></li><li><a href="#从ad域控服务器导出根证书" rel="noopener nofollow">从AD域控服务器导出根证书</a></li><li><a href="#将根证书上传到ssp服务器" rel="noopener nofollow">将根证书上传到SSP服务器</a></li><li><a href="#测试验证结果" rel="noopener nofollow">测试验证结果</a></li><li><a href="#附命令行验证工具" rel="noopener nofollow">附：命令行验证工具</a></li></ul></div><p></p>
<h3 id="环境准备">环境准备</h3>
<ul>
<li>CentOS7.8（优化过Selinux和Firewalld）</li>
<li>php-7.3.33-14.el7.remi.x86_64</li>
<li>self-service-password-1.5.4</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash">yum install -y epel-release yum-utils
yum install -y http://rpms.remirepo.net/enterprise/remi-release-7.rpm
yum-config-manager --enable remi-php73  #安装self-service-password的php版本要求&gt;=7.3
yum install -y php

php -v #版本 7.3.33 (cli)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="安装-self-service-password">安装 self-service-password</h3>
<p>SSP版本列表：<a href="https://ltb-project.org/rpm/7Server/noarch/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ltb-project.org/rpm/7Server/noarch/</a></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cat&gt;/etc/yum.repos.d/ltb-project.repo &lt;&lt;EOF
[ltb-project-noarch]
name=LTB project packages (noarch)
baseurl=https://ltb-project.org/rpm/7Server/noarch
enabled=1
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-LTB-project
EOF

rpm --import https://ltb-project.org/documentation/_static/RPM-GPG-KEY-LTB-project

yum install self-service-password-1.5.4 #低版本SSP适配低版本php
systemctl enable httpd
</code></pre>
<h3 id="修改ssp配置">修改SSP配置</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">rpm -ql self-service-password|grep conf  #查看配置文件
cd /usr/share/self-service-password/conf
cp config.inc.php config.inc.php-bak
</code></pre>
<p>修改 config.inc.php</p>
<pre><code class="language-php">$ldap_url = "ldaps://dc01.xxxyyyzzz.com";
$ldap_binddn = "manager@xxxyyyzzz.com";
$ldap_bindpw = 'XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX';
$ldap_base = "dc=xxxyyyzzz,dc=com";
$ldap_filter = "(&amp;(objectClass=user)($ldap_login_attribute={login})(!(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=2)))";
$ad_options['change_expired_password'] = true;
$who_change_password = "manager";
$keyphrase = "abcdefg1234567";
$ad_mode = true;
$ldap_login_attribute = "sAMAccountName";
</code></pre>
<p>注意：manager账号用来执行密码修改操作，需要有对应权限<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1075587/202608/1075587-20260831172839221-1842195020.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="从ad域控服务器导出根证书">从AD域控服务器导出根证书</h3>
<ol>
<li>添加管理单元</li>
</ol>
<p>win+R输入 <code>mmc</code> ，打开证书控制台。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1075587/202608/1075587-20260831173000134-1592020794.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1075587/202608/1075587-20260831173028243-1393191530.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<ol start="2">
<li>导出CA证书</li>
</ol>
<p>在【受信任的根证书颁发机构】中的【证书】文件夹中，找到站点域名相应的CA证书</p>
<p>右键&gt;&gt;&gt;所有任务&gt;&gt;&gt;导出（格式选择Base64编码格式）</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1075587/202608/1075587-20260831173242598-1802590244.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="将根证书上传到ssp服务器">将根证书上传到SSP服务器</h3>
<p>假设导出CA证书文件名：AD_root_ca.cer</p>
<ul>
<li>【推荐】方法1：</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mv AD_root_ca.cer /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/
update-ca-trust extract
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>方法2：</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mv AD_root_ca.cer /etc/openldap/certs/AD_root_ca.cer
</code></pre>
<p>修改/etc/openldap/ldap.conf</p>
<pre><code>TLS_CACERT /etc/openldap/certs/AD_root_ca.cer
</code></pre>
<h3 id="测试验证结果">测试验证结果</h3>
<p>浏览器打开 <a href="http://xn--SSPIP-n86ht9t5l1b/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://SSP服务器IP/</a></p>
<p>输入您的旧密码并设置新密码：<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1075587/202608/1075587-20260831174054451-423118638.png" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="附命令行验证工具">附：命令行验证工具</h3>
<p>验证CA证书：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">openssl x509 -in /etc/openldap/certs/AD_root_ca.cer -text -noout
</code></pre>
<p>验证用户密码：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">yum install openldap-clients
ldapsearch -x -H ldap://dc01.xxxyyyzzz.com:389 -D "cn=manager,dc=xxxyyyzzz,dc=com" -b "dc=xxxyyyzzz,dc=com" -W "CN=aaa"
</code></pre>


</div>
